tabbhāva.cp: masc. that state; the real nature.
tabbhāva.p: [Ta+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 (1) Tabbho, (related words) of that. (2) that (such as contemplation/thinking). See - Tabbhāvajotana. (3) State of affairs of that... (4) Happening for .....that (or) that happens. See also - Tabbhāvabhāvī. (5) It happens ...due to that.

B:
tabbhāva： tabbhāva（pu）
တဗ်ဘာဝ（ပု）
[ta+bhāva]
[တ+ဘာဝ]
C: tabbhāva：[m．] that state； the real nature．
R:
tabbhāva：တဗ်ဘာဝ （ပ）
ထို အဖြစ်။

tabbhāgiya.p: [Tabbhāga+iya] (ti) CL=7 (1) It is the property of that... part. (2) It has that... part.

B:
tabbhāgiya： tabbhāgiya（ti）
တဗ်ဘာဂိယ（တိ）
[tabbhāga+iya]
[တဗ်ဘာဂ+ဣယ]
K:
tabbhāgiya：တဗ်ဘာဂိယ（တိ）
[တဗ်ဘာဂ+ဣယ]
（၁） ထို．．．၏ အဖို့၏ ဥစ္စာဖြစ်သော။ （၂） ထို．．．အဖို့ရှိသော။
R:
tabbhāgiya：တဗ်ဘာဂိယ （တိ） （တဒ်+ဘာဂိယ）
ထို အဖို့ရှိသည်။

tabbhāgiyavāra.p: [Tabbhāgiya+vāra] (pu) CL=7 Turn of sermon which preaches by Tabbhāgiya saddā. (Tabbhāgiya means related to that; concerned with that).
a: တဗ႓ာဂိယဝါရ(ပု)
တဗ႓ာဂိယ-သဒ္ဒါဖြင့် ဟောအပ်သော-ဝါရ-ဒေသနာ အလှည့်အကြိမ်။

B:

တဗ်ဘာဂိယဝါရ（ပု）
[tabbhāgiya+vāra]
[တဗ်ဘာဂိယ+ဝါရ]
